audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].side said Akali while win[4] said Azir; phases[5].side said Skill while win[5] said Akali; phases[6].side said Skill while win[6] said Azir. Three rows rendered two different answers.
audit.why: packet.levelChart agrees with the content layer (Akali, Akali, Skill, Skill, Azir, Akali, Azir), so the full layer was the odd one out on rows 4-6.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides aligned to the packet and content layer, with the matching why rewritten so the sentence argues the same verdict as the row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and First-item rows carried generic Azir spike prose that ignored Akali's ultimate entirely.
audit.why: Perfect Execution is 120/90/60 — a two-part dash where the recast executes. At rank 2 it is 90s, at rank 3 it is 60s, which is a reset every fight; Emperor's Divide is 120/105/90 and knocks her out of the dive.
audit.corrected: Level 6 row now states R-answers-R; First item row states her 90s R gives one all-in per wave; late/carry keyed to the 60s R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing stated that Shuriken Flip marks the first enemy OR smoke cloud it hits, and nothing stated that her R's recast executes.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'The first enemy or smoke cloud hit is marked. Re-cast to dash to the marked target.' A sand soldier body in that line is not a champion, so where you stand relative to your soldier decides whether she gets the mark on you. R recast 'executes all enemies she strikes'.
audit.corrected: Stated in dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and enemyWin; execute threshold called out as an HP number to track.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it.
audit.why: Lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT; it is the field that holds real numbers.
audit.corrected: Twilight Shroud 20s at rank 1 and free to cast, Shuriken Flip 16s at rank 1, Perfect Execution 120s at rank 1, your E 19s at rank 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Shadow Dance' used twice for Akali's R (whys[5], spikes[1].text, mid).
audit.why: The kit file names the R Perfect Execution. Shadow Dance is not her ability name.
audit.corrected: Replaced with Perfect Execution in all three fields.

notes: CHART: three cross-layer disagreements existed (phases[4].side Akali vs win[4] Azir, phases[5].side Skill vs win[5] Akali, phases[6].side Skill vs win[6] Azir). packet.levelChart matched the content layer on all seven rows, so I moved the full layer to match the packet and rewrote each affected why in the same proposal. No paired win[N] edits are included because win[4..6] already hold the target values on disk; this proposal removes disagreements rather than creating them. Level 6 going to Azir is the packet's and the content layer's verdict, not mine — Emperor's Divide genuinely answers her dive, but if the user prefers Akali on Level 6 that row and win[4] should be flipped together. Anti-heal: her sustain comes from Q's healing in Riot's champion text, which is not in the kit file's ability text here, so I left the anti-heal timing claim in report[8] unchanged beyond the pronoun.
